sentences.zh: 他大约四年前雇佣了桑德，并让他成为九人律师团队中最年轻的检察官，该团队负责处理全州各地的棘手案件。

sentences.en: This one, having to do with a suspicious lottery ticket worth $16.5 million was full of dead ends.

sentences.zh: 最诱人的证据是一张DVD，里面有两段来自加油站的模糊监控录像。

sentences.zh: 那是圣诞节前两天的一个工作日下午。

sentences.en: The hood of the man's black sweatshirt was pulled over his head, obscuring his face from two surveillance cameras overhead.
sentences.zh: 男子黑色卫衣的兜帽拉在头上，遮住了他，避开了上方两个监控摄像头的拍摄。

sentences.en: Under the hoodie, he appeared to be wearing a ball cap.
sentences.zh: 在卫衣下面，他似乎戴着一顶棒球帽。

sentences.zh: 卫衣外面，他穿着一件黑色夹克。

sentences.en: The man grabbed a fountain drink and two hot dogs.
sentences.zh: 男子拿了一杯饮料和两个热狗。

sentences.en: Hello, the cashier said brightly.
sentences.zh: 你好，收银员热情地说道。

sentences.en: The man replied in a low-pitched drawl, a voice that struck Sand as distinct.
sentences.zh: 男子用低沉的拖长音回答，这个声音让桑德觉得很特别。

sentences.en: Hello?
sentences.zh: 你好？

sentences.en: Couple hot dogs?
sentences.zh: 要两个热狗吗？

sentences.en: The cashier asked.
sentences.zh: 收银员问道。

sentences.en: Yes, sir, the man replied quietly, his head down.
sentences.zh: 是的，先生，男子低着头轻声回答。

sentences.en: The man pulled two pieces of paper from his pocket.
sentences.zh: 男子从口袋里掏出两张纸。

sentences.en: They were play slips for Hot Lotto, a Powerball-like lottery game available in 14 states and Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 那是Hot Lotto的投注单，这是一种类似于强力球的彩票游戏，在14个州和华盛顿特区都有销售。

sentences.en: A player, or the game's computer, picked five numbers between 1 and 39, and then a sixth number, known as the Hot Ball, between 1 and 19.
sentences.zh: 玩家或游戏的计算机在1到39之间选择五个数字，然后选择第六个数字，即“热球”，范围在1到19之间。

sentences.en: The prize for getting the first five numbers right was $10,000, but a much larger prize that varied according to the
sentences.zh: 猜中前五个数字的奖金是1万美元，但如果猜中所有六个数字，奖金会根据购买彩票的玩家人数而大幅增加。

sentences.en: number of players who bought tickets went to anyone who got all six numbers right.

sentences.zh: Hot Lotto近2000万美元的创纪录头奖是在2007年被领走的。

sentences.en: The jackpot at the time of this video was approaching the record.
sentences.zh: 视频拍摄时，头奖金额正接近这一纪录。

sentences.zh: 中奖的既定概率是10,939,383分之一。

sentences.en: The cashier took the man's play slips, which had already been filled out with multiple sets of numbers.
sentences.zh: 收银员拿走了男子的投注单，上面已经填好了多组数字。

sentences.en: At 3.24 p.m., the cashier ran the slips through the lottery terminal.

sentences.en: An older man with a cane limped by the refrigerated section.
sentences.zh: 一位拄着拐杖的老人从冷藏区走过。

sentences.en: A bus drove by.
sentences.zh: 一辆公共汽车开了过去。

sentences.en: The cashier handed over his change.

sentences.en: Once outside, the man pulled down his hood and removed his cap, got into his SUV, and drove away.
sentences.zh: 走出店外后，男子拉下兜帽，摘下帽子，坐进他的SUV，开车离开了。

sentences.en: The gas station parking lot gleamed.
sentences.zh: 加油站的停车场闪闪发光。

sentences.en: There had been snow flurries that afternoon.
sentences.zh: 那天下午曾有阵雪。

sentences.en: Two years into the case, that was virtually all the investigators had.
sentences.zh: 案件调查两年了，这几乎就是调查人员所掌握的全部信息。

sentences.en: Sand watched the video again and again, trying to pick up every little detail the SUVs make.

sentences.en: The man's indistinct appearance, most likely in his 40s and 100 pounds overweight, maybe more, the tenor of his voice.

sentences.en: Sand, a baby-faced Iowan who turned down Harvard Law School for the University of Iowa College of Law, had a background that seemed perfect for the case.
sentences.zh: 桑德是一位长着娃娃脸的爱荷华州人，他曾拒绝哈佛法学院而选择了爱荷华大学法学院，他的背景似乎非常适合这个案件。

sentences.zh: 他最近处理的案件包括证券欺诈和公职人员盗窃。

sentences.zh: 但彩票官员掌握着关键证据，这些证据并未公开。

sentences.en: The serial number on the winning ticket and the video of the man buying it.
sentences.zh: 中奖彩票的序列号和男子购买彩票的视频。

sentences.zh: 他们逐一排除了潜在的索赔人。

sentences.en: His description, a sports coat and gray flannel dress pants, did not match the quick trip video.

sentences.zh: 随后，在接下来的通话中，该男子承认他撒谎了。

sentences.zh: 他说他是在帮客户领取彩票，这样客户就不会被曝光身份。

sentences.zh: 人们谈论它时带着一种苦涩的幽默。

sentences.zh: “我们可能会发现买彩票的那个人最后被干掉了，”桑德说。

sentences.en: That's what this is going to turn out to be a murder case.
sentences.zh: “这最后可能会变成一起谋杀案。”

sentences.en: Miller had mentored Sand and saw in him a kindred spirit, someone for whom practicing law was a calling.
sentences.zh: 米勒曾指导过桑德，并视他为志同道合的人，一个认为从事法律工作是一种使命的人。

sentences.en: Sometimes Sand's moral compass was so steady that he came off as a square.
sentences.zh: 有时桑德的道德准则太稳固了，以至于他显得有些古板。

sentences.en: His brothers-in-law nicknamed him Baby Jesus.
sentences.zh: 他的连襟给他起了个绰号叫“小耶稣”。

sentences.en: Sand grew up in Decorah in northeast Iowa, the son of a small town doctor who still made house calls.
sentences.zh: 桑德在爱荷华州东北部的迪科拉长大，他的父亲是一位至今仍会上门看病的小镇医生。

sentences.en: He wanted to get into white-collar criminal prosecution because it focused not on crimes of desperation, but on crimes of greed.
sentences.zh: 他想从事白领犯罪起诉工作，因为这关注的不是绝望引发的犯罪，而是贪婪引发的犯罪。

sentences.en: Crimes against gratitude,
sentences.zh: “对感恩的犯罪，”

sentences.en: Sand called them.
sentences.zh: 桑德称之为。

sentences.en: But all he had was grainy video of a man buying a lottery ticket worth $16.5 million.
sentences.zh: 但他手里只有一段模糊的视频，显示一个男人购买了一张价值1650万美元的彩票。

sentences.en: We only had one bullet left in our revolver, Sand says, and that was releasing the video.
sentences.zh: “我们的左轮手枪里只剩下一颗子弹了，”桑德说，“那就是发布这段视频。”

sentences.en: On October 9, 2014, nearly 46 months after the man in the hoodie left the quick trip,
sentences.zh: 2014年10月9日，在穿卫衣的男子离开Quick-Trip近46个月后，

sentences.en: the Iowa Division of Criminal Investigation put out a news release that included a link to a 74-second clip of the surveillance footage.
sentences.zh: 爱荷华州刑事调查部门发布了一份新闻稿，其中包含了一个74秒监控录像片段的链接。

sentences.en: A few days later, in Maine, an employee of the Maine Lottery, opened an email forwarded from his boss.
sentences.zh: 几天后，在缅因州，一名缅因州彩票局的员工打开了老板转发的一封电子邮件。

sentences.en: The employee recognized the distinct voice in the video.
sentences.zh: 这名员工认出了视频中那个独特的声音。

sentences.en: It belonged to a man who had spent a week in the Maine Lottery offices a few years earlier, conducting a security audit.
sentences.zh: 它属于一个几年前曾在缅因州彩票局办公室待过一周，进行安全审计的男人。

sentences.en: In Des Moines, a web developer at the Iowa Lottery who watched the video also recognized that voice.
sentences.zh: 在得梅因，爱荷华州彩票局的一名网页开发人员在观看视频时也认出了那个声音。

sentences.en: It belonged to a man she had worked alongside for years.
sentences.zh: 它属于一个她曾共事多年的男人。

sentences.en: A receptionist in another lottery office handed her earbuds to Noelle Kruger, a draw manager, and told her to listen.
sentences.zh: 另一家彩票办公室的一名前台接待员把耳机递给抽奖经理诺埃尔·克鲁格，让她听听。

sentences.en: Why am I listening to a video or listening to a tape of Eddie?
sentences.zh: “我为什么要听一段视频，或者听一段埃迪的录音？”

sentences.en: Kruger replied.
sentences.zh: 克鲁格反问道。

sentences.en: By Eddie, she meant Eddie Tipton, the information security director for the Multi-State Lottery Association.
sentences.zh: 她所说的埃迪，是指多州彩票协会的信息安全主管埃迪·蒂普顿。

sentences.en: The organization runs lotteries for 33 different states, plus the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, and the U.S.
sentences.zh: 该组织为33个不同的州，以及哥伦比亚特区、波多黎各和美国

sentences.en: Virgin Islands.
sentences.zh: 维尔京群岛运营彩票。

sentences.en: It was based in the Des Moines suburbs.
sentences.zh: 它的总部位于得梅因郊区。

sentences.en: Among the games it ran was the hot lotto.
sentences.zh: 它运营的游戏中包括“热力彩票”。

sentences.en: Eddie Tipton cut a big, friendly figure around the office of the Multi-State Lottery Association.
sentences.zh: 埃迪·蒂普顿在多州彩票协会办公室里是一个身材魁梧、待人友善的人物。

sentences.en: He grew up in rural Texas, but while his siblings were outside, he was always in his room, fiddling with his computer.
sentences.zh: 他在德克萨斯州的农村长大，但当他的兄弟姐妹都在外面玩耍时，他总是待在房间里摆弄电脑。

sentences.en: He was a paranoid sort who rarely paid with credit cards, who worried about people tracing his identity.
sentences.zh: 他是个多疑的人，很少用信用卡支付，总是担心别人追踪他的身份。

sentences.en: But he always wanted people to like him.
sentences.zh: 但他总是希望别人喜欢他。

sentences.en: When a co-worker was in a bad mood, one colleague said, Tipton would pat him on the shoulder and say, I just want you to know I'm your friend.
sentences.zh: 一位同事说，当有同事心情不好时，蒂普顿会拍拍他的肩膀说：“我只是想让你知道，我是你的朋友。”

sentences.en: Tipton built a 4,800-square-foot, $540,000 house in the cornfields south of Des Moines.
sentences.zh: 蒂普顿在得梅因以南的玉米地里盖了一栋4800平方英尺、价值54万美元的房子。

sentences.en: The house had five bedrooms and a huge basement, including a pool table, a shuffleboard table, a stadium-style home theater with couches, and a space he considered
sentences.zh: 房子有五间卧室和一个巨大的地下室，包括一张台球桌、一张沙狐球桌、一个带有沙发和体育场式座位的家庭影院，以及一个他考虑

sentences.en: turning into a basketball court.
sentences.zh: 改建成篮球场的空间。

sentences.en: Friends wondered why a single man needed such a big house and how he could afford it on a salary just shy of $100,000 a year.
sentences.zh: 朋友们很纳闷，一个单身汉为什么需要这么大的房子，而且他年薪不到10万美元，怎么负担得起。

sentences.en: In private moments, Tipton told them he was lonely and wanted a family more than anything, so he poured his savings into the house he hoped to fill with a wife and children.
sentences.zh: 私下里，蒂普顿告诉他们，他很孤独，最渴望拥有一个家庭，所以他把积蓄都投入到了这栋房子里，希望能有妻子和孩子住进来。

sentences.en: But the right partner never came.
sentences.zh: 但合适的伴侣一直没有出现。

sentences.en: Instead, he hosted office Christmas parties, and he constantly asked friends to visit.
sentences.zh: 相反，他经常举办办公室圣诞派对，并不断邀请朋友来访。

sentences.en: His family, still in Texas, checked on him frequently.
sentences.zh: 他远在德克萨斯州的家人经常过问他的情况。

sentences.en: His life revolved around his job.
sentences.zh: 他的生活围绕着工作展开。

sentences.en: The Multi-State Lottery Association was a small organization, and Tipton felt overextended.
sentences.zh: 多州彩票协会是一个小型组织，蒂普顿感到工作负担过重。

sentences.en: He wrote software and worked on web pages.
sentences.zh: 他编写软件并负责网页工作。

sentences.en: He handled network security and firewalls, and he reviewed security for lottery games in nearly three dozen states.
sentences.zh: 他处理网络安全和防火墙，并审查了近三十个州的彩票游戏安全性。

sentences.en: He was putting in 60-hour weeks and staying at the office until 11 p.m.
sentences.zh: 他每周工作60个小时，经常在办公室待到晚上11点。

sentences.en: When Ed Steffen, the chief information officer and chief security officer at the Multi-State Lottery
sentences.zh: 当多州彩票协会的首席信息官兼首席安全官埃德·斯蒂芬

sentences.en: Association, saw the surveillance video, he didn't want to believe it.
sentences.zh: 看到监控视频时，他不敢相信自己的眼睛。

sentences.en: This wasn't just some co-worker.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是某个同事。

sentences.en: This was Eddie Tipton, a man he had known for more than two decades since they were in calculus class at the University of Houston.
sentences.zh: 这是埃迪·蒂普顿，一个他认识了二十多年的人，他们曾一起在休斯顿大学上微积分课。

sentences.en: Steffen met his future wife while he and Tipton were on a charity bike ride in Texas.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬是在他和蒂普顿参加德克萨斯州的一次慈善骑行活动时认识他未来的妻子的。

sentences.en: Tipton would later be in their wedding.
sentences.zh: 后来蒂普顿还参加了他们的婚礼。

sentences.en: Steffen helped Tipton get his job at the association.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬帮助蒂普顿在协会找到了工作。

sentences.en: They bought some 50 acres of land together and built adjacent houses.
sentences.zh: 他们一起买了大约50英亩的土地，并盖了相邻的房子。

sentences.en: They even applied for a joint patent for computer-based lottery security.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至共同申请了一项基于计算机的彩票安全专利。

sentences.en: Steffen watched the convenience store video for the first time after a former co-worker sent him the link that had been released by prosecutors.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬是在一位前同事发给他检察官发布的链接后，第一次看到这段便利店视频的。

sentences.en: That just can't be Eddie, he thought.
sentences.zh: “那绝对不可能是埃迪，”他想。

sentences.en: Then, that's Eddie.
sentences.zh: “等等，那是埃迪。”

sentences.en: Why is he wearing a hoodie?
sentences.zh: “他为什么穿着连帽衫？”

sentences.en: I've never seen Eddie in a hoodie.
sentences.zh: “我从没见过埃迪穿连帽衫。”

sentences.en: Steffen got sick to his stomach.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬感到一阵恶心。

sentences.en: His friend, a man with deep knowledge of the computers that ran the lottery, was there on screen buying a ticket that would be worth
sentences.zh: 他的朋友，一个对运营彩票的计算机有着深厚知识的人，正出现在屏幕上，购买一张价值

sentences.en: $16.5 million.
sentences.zh: 1650万美元的彩票。

sentences.en: Later, Steffen would tell investigators it was like finding out your mother was an axe murderer.
sentences.zh: 后来，斯蒂芬告诉调查人员，这就像发现你母亲是个杀人犯一样。

sentences.en: He felt betrayed.
sentences.zh: 他感到被背叛了。

sentences.en: Jason Marr was another friend and colleague who didn't want to believe what he was seeing on the video.
sentences.zh: 杰森·马尔是另一位朋友兼同事，他也不愿相信自己在视频中看到的一切。

sentences.en: He and Tipton had met at Taki, a Japanese restaurant outside Des Moines that they both frequented.
sentences.zh: 他和蒂普顿是在得梅因郊外的一家日本餐厅“Taki”认识的，他们都经常去那里。

sentences.en: The lifelong computer aficionados and gamers hit it off.
sentences.zh: 这两个终身的电脑发烧友和游戏玩家一见如故。

sentences.en: Tipton joined
sentences.zh: 蒂普顿加入了

sentences.en: Marr's gaming clan, and they spent hours playing the multiplayer online game World of Tanks.
sentences.zh: 马尔的游戏战队，他们花了好几个小时玩多人在线游戏《坦克世界》。

sentences.en: Tipton suggested Marr apply for a job at the Lottery Association as a network engineer.
sentences.zh: 蒂普顿建议马尔申请彩票协会的网络工程师职位。

sentences.en: Tipton, Marr told me, had a heart of gold.
sentences.zh: 马尔告诉我，蒂普顿有一颗金子般的心。

sentences.en: So when Marr saw the video and heard that familiar low-pitched voice, he did what a computer whiz does.
sentences.zh: 所以当马尔看到视频并听到那个熟悉的低沉嗓音时，他做了电脑天才该做的事。

sentences.en: That night I sat down.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上我坐了下来。

sentences.en: There's no way Eddie did this,
sentences.zh: “埃迪不可能做这种事，”

sentences.en: Marr said.
sentences.zh: 马尔说。

sentences.en: There's got to be something wrong.
sentences.zh: “肯定有什么地方不对劲。”

sentences.en: He put the file of the surveillance tape into audio software, removed white noise, and isolated the voice.
sentences.zh: 他把监控录像文件放入音频软件中，去除了白噪音，并提取出了声音。

sentences.en: Then he took footage from security cameras in his house.
sentences.zh: 然后他拿到了他家里的监控摄像头拍摄的录像。

sentences.en: Tipton had just visited the night before and compared Tipton's voice in that footage with the convenience store video.
sentences.zh: 蒂普顿前一天晚上刚来过，他将录像中蒂普顿的声音与便利店视频中的声音进行了对比。

sentences.en: It was a complete and utter match.
sentences.zh: 完全吻合。

sentences.en: Sound wave and everything,
sentences.zh: “声波什么的都一样，”

sentences.en: Marr said.
sentences.zh: 马尔说。

sentences.en: The next day, he went to the quick trip where the ticket was purchased and measured the
sentences.zh: 第二天，他去了购买彩票的那家便利店，测量了

sentences.en: dimensions of the tiles on the floor, the height of the shelving units, the distance between the door and the cash register.
sentences.zh: 地板瓷砖的尺寸、货架的高度、门和收银台之间的距离。

sentences.en: He used the results to compare the hand size, foot size, and height of the man in the video with the man he had become friends with.
sentences.zh: 他利用这些结果将视频中男子的手部大小、脚部大小和身高与他结识的朋友进行了对比。

sentences.en: When the FBI guys came in, I wanted to be able to tell them it wasn't Eddie, Marr said.
sentences.zh: “当联邦调查局的人来的时候，我希望能告诉他们那不是埃迪，”马尔说。

sentences.en: Once I did this, it was like, well, it's Eddie.
sentences.zh: “一旦我做了这些对比，我就觉得，好吧，那就是埃迪。”

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费试用《时报》一个月，而且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，免费获取30天的访问权限。

sentences.en: In November 2014, state investigators showed up at Tipton's office.
sentences.zh: 2014年11月，州调查人员出现在蒂普顿的办公室。

sentences.en: They asked him whom he knew in Houston.
sentences.zh: 他们问他在休斯顿认识谁。

sentences.en: He told them about his family, mother, sister, and brothers, including Tommy, a former sheriff's deputy turned justice of the peace near the Texas Hill Country.
sentences.zh: 他告诉他们关于家人的情况，包括母亲、姐妹和兄弟，其中汤米曾是警长副手，后来在德克萨斯州希尔乡村附近担任治安官。

sentences.en: He did not mention Robert Rhodes, the man who initially passed the $16.5 million ticket to an attorney.
sentences.zh: 他没有提到罗伯特·罗兹，那个最初把1650万美元彩票交给律师的人。

sentences.en: By searching Tipton's LinkedIn profile, investigators found that Tipton had been employed at Rhodes'
sentences.zh: 通过搜索蒂普顿的领英资料，调查人员发现蒂普顿曾在罗兹的

sentences.en: Texas-based software company, Systems Evolution, for six years as its chief operations officer.
sentences.zh: 德克萨斯州软件公司“系统进化”工作了六年，担任首席运营官。

sentences.en: In fact, the two were best friends and vacationed together.
sentences.zh: 事实上，两人是最好的朋友，还一起去度假。

sentences.en: Tipton was arrested in January 2015 and charged with two felony counts of fraud.
sentences.zh: 蒂普顿于2015年1月被捕，并被控两项重罪欺诈罪。

sentences.en: Half a year later, on a hot, sticky July morning,
sentences.zh: 半年后，在一个炎热潮湿的七月早晨，

sentences.en: Rob Sand stood before a jury at the Polk County Courthouse.
sentences.zh: 罗伯·桑德站在波尔克县法院的陪审团面前。

sentences.en: This is a classic story about an inside job, he began.
sentences.zh: “这是一个关于内部作案的经典故事，”他开场说道。

sentences.en: A man who, by virtue of his employment, is not allowed to play the lottery, nor allowed to win, buys a lottery ticket, wins,
sentences.zh: “一个凭借职务之便本不允许购买彩票，也不允许中奖的人，买了一张彩票，中奖了，

sentences.en: and passes the ticket along to friends to be claimed by someone unconnected to him.
sentences.zh: 然后把彩票转交给朋友，由一个与他无关的人去领奖。”

sentences.en: This story, though, has a 21st century twiSt. The prosecution knew Tipton had bought the winning ticket.
sentences.zh: “不过，这个故事有一个21世纪的转折。”检方知道蒂普顿买了那张中奖彩票。

sentences.en: The video, specifically the distinct voice that colleagues had recognized, made that clear.
sentences.zh: 视频，特别是同事们认出的独特嗓音，清楚地证明了这一点。

sentences.en: So did cell phone records, which showed Tipton was in town that day, not out of town for the
sentences.zh: 手机记录也证明了这一点，记录显示蒂普顿那天在城里，而不是像他声称的那样去

sentences.en: holidays as he claimed, and that he had been on the phone for 71 minutes with Robert Rhodes, the man who briefly had possession of the ticket.
sentences.zh: 度假了，而且他与短暂持有彩票的罗伯特·罗兹通了71分钟的电话。

sentences.en: Investigators believe he'd fixed the lottery.
sentences.zh: 调查人员认为他操纵了彩票。

sentences.en: But how?
sentences.zh: 但怎么做到的？

sentences.en: Jason Marr, Tipton's gaming buddy, told them about Tipton's interest in rootkits, malicious software that can be installed via flash drive in order to take control of a computer
sentences.zh: 蒂普顿的游戏好友杰森·马尔告诉他们，蒂普顿对Rootkit感兴趣，这是一种可以通过闪存驱动器安装的恶意软件，旨在控制计算机，

sentences.en: while masking its existence until it deletes itself later.
sentences.zh: 同时掩盖其存在，直到以后自动删除。

sentences.en: Sand theorized that Tipton went into the draw room six weeks before the big jackpot and, despite the presence of two colleagues,
sentences.zh: 桑德推测，蒂普顿在开奖前六周进入了抽奖室，尽管有两名同事在场，

sentences.en: managed to insert a thumb drive into one of the two computers that selected the winning numbers.
sentences.zh: 还是设法将一个拇指驱动器插入了选择中奖号码的两台计算机之一。

sentences.en: That thumb drive contained the rootkit.
sentences.zh: 那个拇指驱动器里装的就是Rootkit。

sentences.en: The rootkit allowed Tipton to direct which numbers would win the hot lotto on December 29, 2010.
sentences.zh: Rootkit让蒂普顿能够决定2010年12月29日“热力彩票”的中奖号码。

sentences.en: Tipton's defense attorney, Dean Stowers, called this the mission-impossible theory.
sentences.zh: 蒂普顿的辩护律师迪恩·斯托尔斯称这是“不可能完成的任务”理论。

sentences.en: Stowers characterized the story of a malicious, self-destructing rootkit, magic software, installed while two colleagues looked on as preposterous.
sentences.zh: 斯托尔斯将关于恶意、自毁的Rootkit（一种魔法软件）在两名同事注视下安装的故事描述为荒谬可笑。

sentences.en: His closing arguments referenced a quotation attributed to Albert Einstein, logic will get you from A to B.
sentences.zh: 他的结案陈词引用了归于阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦名下的一句话：“逻辑会带你从A点到达B点。”

sentences.en: Imagination will take you anywhere.
sentences.zh: “想象力会带你去任何地方。”

sentences.en: But Sand called Stowers's focus on this complicated rootkit theory a red herring.
sentences.zh: 但桑德称斯托尔斯对这个复杂的Rootkit理论的关注是转移视线。

sentences.en: Sand told the jury to focus on the many ways Tipton could have fixed the lottery.

sentences.en: He wrote the code.
sentences.zh: 他编写了代码。

sentences.en: He had access to the random number generator machines before they were shipped to other states.
sentences.zh: 他在随机数生成机运往其他州之前就能接触到它们。

sentences.en: You don't have to understand the exact technology to convict Tipton, Sand argued.
sentences.zh: 桑德辩称，你不需要了解确切的技术也能给蒂普顿定罪。

sentences.en: You just have to realize the near-impossible coincidence of the lottery security chief's buying a winning ticket and that ticket's being passed to his best friend.
sentences.zh: 你只需要意识到彩票安全主管购买中奖彩票，且该彩票被转交给其最好的朋友，这种巧合几乎是不可能的。

sentences.en: The prosecution had to prove only that Tipton tried to illegally buy lottery tickets as a multi-state

sentences.en: The jury found him guilty on July 20, 2015.
sentences.zh: 陪审团于2015年7月20日裁定他有罪。

sentences.en: He would be sentenced to 10 years in prison and he would appeal.
sentences.zh: 他被判处10年监禁，并将提出上诉。

sentences.en: The state Supreme Court later dismissed his conviction on one charge, tampering with lottery equipment, and the case was sent back to district court.

sentences.en: Six weeks after the trial concluded, Sand had returned to his desk.
sentences.zh: 审判结束六周后，桑德回到了他的办公桌前。

sentences.en: It had been a busy summer.
sentences.zh: 那是一个忙碌的夏天。

sentences.en: But in the back of his mind, he was still thinking about Eddie Tipton.
sentences.zh: 但在内心深处，他还在想埃迪·蒂普顿。

sentences.en: Sand knew white-collar criminals aren't usually caught on their first attempt.
sentences.zh: 桑德知道白领罪犯通常不会在第一次尝试时就被抓获。

sentences.en: The fact that Tipton's attorney had demanded a 90-day speedy trial, an unusual maneuver that cut short the prosecution's time to investigate, made Sand suspicious.
sentences.zh: 蒂普顿的律师要求90天内快速审判，这是一种缩短检方调查时间的异常策略，这让桑德产生了怀疑。

sentences.en: His gut said other fraudulent lottery tickets were out there.
sentences.zh: 他的直觉告诉他，还有其他欺诈性的彩票中奖者存在。

sentences.en: One morning, Sand's office phone rang, and an area code he recognized popped up.
sentences.zh: 一天早上，桑德办公室的电话响了，显示出一个他熟悉的区号。

sentences.en: 281, from Texas, where Tipton used to live.

sentences.zh: 举报人问：“你们知道吗，埃迪的兄弟，

sentences.zh: 理查德·雷尼森的电话在德克萨斯城联邦调查局办公室响了，那是一个位于加尔维斯顿湾岸边的港口城市。

sentences.en: Sand was on the line, inquiring about a case that Renison, a special agent for the Bureau, investigated a decade before.
sentences.zh: 桑德在电话那头，询问雷尼森（该局的一名特别探员）十年前调查过的一起案件。

sentences.en: At the time, it turned out to be nothing.
sentences.zh: 当时，结果证明什么也没查出来。

sentences.en: But the case still stuck in Renison's mind.
sentences.zh: 但这个案子一直留在雷尼森的脑海里。

sentences.en: Hey, Renison replied, that's my
sentences.zh: “嘿，”雷尼森回答说，“那是我的

sentences.en: A man named Tom Bargis had contacted local law enforcement authorities in early 2006 with a suspicious story.
sentences.zh: 一个名叫汤姆·巴吉斯的人在2006年初联系了当地执法部门，讲述了一个可疑的故事。

sentences.en: Bargis owned 44 fireworks stands in Texas.
sentences.zh: 巴吉斯在德克萨斯州拥有44个烟花摊位。

sentences.en: Twice a year, after the 4th of July and after New Year's, he had to handle enormous amounts of cash, more than a half million dollars at once.
sentences.zh: 每年两次，在7月4日之后和新年之后，他都必须处理巨额现金，一次超过50万美元。

sentences.zh: 一位给巴吉斯马匹钉马掌的当地治安官在新年左右给他打了电话。

sentences.en: The
sentences.zh: 那位

sentences.en: Justice of the Peace caught Bargis off guard.
sentences.zh: 治安官让巴吉斯措手不及。

sentences.zh: “我有50万现金，想换成你的钱。”

sentences.en: Bargis replied.
sentences.zh: 巴吉斯回答道。

sentences.zh: 巴吉斯心想，一个年薪约3.5万美元的治安官怎么会有那么多现金？

sentences.en: He called the sheriff and the police who called the FBI.
sentences.zh: 他打电话给警长和警察，他们又联系了联邦调查局。

sentences.en: Soon, the Bureau contacted Bargis.
sentences.zh: 很快，联邦调查局联系了巴吉斯。

sentences.en: Federal agents outfitted him with a wire.
sentences.zh: 联邦探员给他装上了窃听器。

sentences.en: Bargis met with the man who pulled out a briefcase filled with $450,000 in cash still in their Federal
sentences.zh: 巴吉斯与那个人见了面，那人拿出一个公文包，里面装满了45万美元的现金，仍然用着联邦

sentences.en: Reserve wrappers.
sentences.zh: 储备银行的包装纸。

sentences.en: As the FBI listened, Bargis swapped $100,000 of worn, circulated bills for $100,000 of the man's crisp, unused bills.
sentences.zh: 在联邦调查局的监听下，巴吉斯用那人的一叠崭新未使用的钞票，换走了自己手中那叠磨损、流通已久的10万美元。

sentences.en: To the FBI, this smelled like public corruption, and they went to work investigating the serial numbers on the bills.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局认为这闻起来像是公职腐败，于是他们开始着手调查这些钞票上的序列号。

sentences.en: One day, a couple of months later, Renison got a call from the Fayette County Sheriff in La Grange, a place best known for the chicken ranch, the brothel
sentences.zh: 几个月后的一天，雷尼森接到了拉格兰奇费耶特县警长的电话，那个地方最出名的是“鸡场”，也就是那家妓院，

sentences.en: that inspired the best little whorehouse in Texas.
sentences.zh: 它启发了《德州最棒的小妓院》这部作品。

sentences.en: The sheriff was laughing so hard he could hardly speak.
sentences.zh: 警长笑得几乎说不出话来。

sentences.en: He told Renison the Justice of the Peace was holed up in a Houston hospital with two shattered legs.
sentences.zh: 他告诉雷尼森，那位治安法官正躲在休斯顿的一家医院里，双腿骨折。

sentences.en: He had fallen 31 feet out of a tree.
sentences.zh: 他从树上掉了下来，摔了31英尺高。

sentences.en: He had been hunting Bigfoot.
sentences.zh: 当时他正在猎捕大脚怪。

sentences.en: My grandmother was raised on a farm in Arkansas where this creature would come in and harass all the farm animals, this man later told investigators.
sentences.zh: 这名男子后来告诉调查人员：“我祖母是在阿肯色州的一个农场长大的，当时这种生物会跑进来骚扰所有的农场动物。”

sentences.en: My grandmother would tell me all these stories of this animal that harassed my family.
sentences.zh: “我祖母会给我讲所有关于这种动物骚扰我们家的故事。”

sentences.en: He went on, I started hitting the woods.
sentences.zh: 他继续说道：“我开始钻进树林里。”

sentences.en: It was always that doubt in your mind.
sentences.zh: “你心中总会有那种怀疑。”

sentences.en: And then something happened to me in Louisiana where I actually watched these animals for a couple of hours, and I've been hooked ever since.
sentences.zh: “后来在路易斯安那州发生了一件事，我亲眼观察了这些动物几个小时，从那以后我就彻底着迷了。”

sentences.en: Renison visited the man in the hospital and then set up an interview.
sentences.zh: 雷尼森去医院探望了那名男子，并安排了一次访谈。

sentences.en: Once he was discharged, the man was a member of the Bigfoot Field Researcher's Organization.
sentences.zh: 出院后，这名男子成为了“大脚怪实地研究组织”的一员。

sentences.en: He told Renison he'd won the lottery in Colorado while on a Bigfoot hunt.
sentences.zh: 他告诉雷尼森，他在科罗拉多州猎捕大脚怪时中了彩票。

sentences.en: He was on the outs with his wife and was trying to keep the lottery winnings from her.
sentences.zh: 当时他正与妻子闹矛盾，想把彩票奖金瞒着她。

sentences.en: A Bigfoot hunting friend claimed the prize in exchange for 10% of the money.
sentences.zh: 一位一起猎捕大脚怪的朋友以10%的奖金作为交换，代为领取了奖金。

sentences.en: It all checked out.
sentences.zh: 一切都核实无误。

sentences.en: Case closed.
sentences.zh: 结案。

sentences.en: Right before I leave, we're still sitting down at this nice conference table, and he looks over at his attorneys and says, Can I show him?
sentences.zh: 就在我要离开前，我们还坐在那张漂亮的会议桌旁，他看向他的律师说：“我能给他看吗？”

sentences.en: Renison recalled, Hanging off the back of his chair is a plastic grocery bag.
sentences.zh: 雷尼森回忆道：“他椅背上挂着一个塑料杂货袋。”

sentences.en: He pulls out a plaster cast of a footprint.
sentences.zh: 他从中掏出了一个石膏做的脚印模型。

sentences.en: Renison put the footprint next to his own foot.
sentences.zh: 雷尼森把那个脚印放在自己的脚边比对。

sentences.en: They were roughly the same size.
sentences.zh: 它们的大小差不多。

sentences.en: That doesn't look like Bigfoot, the FBI agent said.
sentences.zh: “那看起来不像大脚怪的，”联邦调查局探员说。

sentences.en: It was a juvenile, the man snapped.
sentences.zh: “那是只幼崽，”那人反驳道。

sentences.en: The man's name was Tommy Tipton.
sentences.zh: 这名男子的名字叫汤米·蒂普顿。

sentences.en: Now the hunt was on for more illicitly claimed tickets.
sentences.zh: 现在，搜寻更多非法领取的彩票的工作开始了。

sentences.en: We first thought, whoa, this is our first body related to this case, Sand says.
sentences.zh: “我们起初以为，哇，这是我们这起案件中发现的第一具尸体，”桑德说。

sentences.en: It wasn't.
sentences.zh: 其实并不是。

sentences.en: Hicks had died of cancer.
sentences.zh: 希克斯死于癌症。

sentences.en: The investigators collected a decade's worth of winners from lotteries around the country associated with the Multi-State Lottery Association.
sentences.zh: 调查人员收集了全国各地与“多州彩票协会”相关的十年间的获奖者名单。

sentences.en: They loaded data from approximately 45,000 winning tickets into Microsoft Excel spreadsheets and searched for any connections to Eddie Tipton.
sentences.zh: 他们将大约45,000张中奖彩票的数据录入微软Excel电子表格，并搜索与埃迪·蒂普顿有关的任何联系。

sentences.en: They reviewed Tipton's
sentences.zh: 他们审查了蒂普顿的

sentences.zh: 2015年9月，他们获悉，威斯康星州“Megabucks”游戏的一笔783,257.72美元的奖金

sentences.en: had been claimed in early 2008 by a Texas man named Robert Rhodes, who wanted to deposit it into the account of a limited liability corporation.
sentences.zh: 在2008年初被一名叫罗伯特·罗兹的德州男子领取，他想把钱存入一家有限责任公司的账户。

sentences.en: That drawing took place on December 29, 2007, the same day the winning numbers on Tipton's $16.5 million Iowa ticket were selected three years later.

sentences.en: Rhodes was Eddie Tipton's best friend.
sentences.zh: 罗兹是埃迪·蒂普顿最好的朋友。

sentences.en: Another hit.
sentences.zh: 又是一个线索。

sentences.en: One evening over the holidays, Sand was at his parents' house working on his laptop, sifting through records, using search commands on his computer again and again.
sentences.zh: 假期里的一个晚上，桑德在父母家一边用笔记本电脑工作，一边筛选记录，一遍又一遍地在电脑上使用搜索指令。

sentences.en: He noticed that a Kyle Kahn from Hemphill, Texas won a $644,478 jackpot in the Oklahoma Lottery some years back.
sentences.zh: 他注意到，几年前，一位来自德州亨菲尔的凯尔·卡恩赢得了俄克拉荷马州彩票的644,478美元大奖。

sentences.zh: 汤米·蒂普顿在Facebook上有三个叫卡恩的朋友。

sentences.en: Another hit.

sentences.zh: 其中一张中奖彩票由一名叫克里斯托弗·米库尔斯基的德州人领取，另一张由一名叫艾米·沃威克的爱荷华州女子领取。

sentences.en: Each was a friend of Eddie Tipton's.
sentences.zh: 他们每个人都是埃迪·蒂普顿的朋友。

sentences.zh: 一天清晨，桑德和一名调查员敲开了那名女子的门。

sentences.zh: 她告诉他们，她曾和蒂普顿约会过一次，但他们的关系后来变成了柏拉图式的友谊。

sentences.zh: 蒂普顿告诉她，由于工作原因，他无法领取中奖彩票。

sentences.en: You have these honest dupes, Sand says.
sentences.zh: “你总会遇到这些诚实的受骗者，”桑德说。

sentences.zh: 你只需要知道该找什么。

sentences.en: The smoking gun would help lead to a guilty plea from Tipton.
sentences.zh: 这确凿的证据将有助于促使蒂普顿认罪。

sentences.en: In the plea deal, Sand insisted that Tipton come clean about how he fixed the lottery.
sentences.zh: 在认罪协议中，桑德坚持要求蒂普顿交代他是如何操纵彩票的。

sentences.en: This could help the lottery industry improve its security.
sentences.zh: 这有助于彩票行业提高安全性。

sentences.en: If Tipton lied, or if another fraudulent ticket were found later, the deal would be voided, and Tipton would be subject to further charges.
sentences.zh: 如果蒂普顿撒谎，或者后来又发现了其他欺诈彩票，协议将作废，蒂普顿将面临进一步指控。

sentences.en: Tipton's program was called QVRNG.DLL, Quantum Vision Random Number
sentences.zh: 蒂普顿的程序名为QVRNG.DLL，即量子视觉随机数

sentences.en: Generator.
sentences.zh: 生成器。

sentences.en: In Tipton's telling, his wasn't an evil plan to get rich.
sentences.zh: 在蒂普顿的讲述中，他的计划并非为了发财的邪恶阴谋。

sentences.en: This was just a computer nerd's attempt to crack the system.
sentences.zh: 这只是一个电脑极客试图破解系统的尝试。

sentences.en: It was never my intent to start a full-out ticket scam, Tipton told investigators.
sentences.zh: “我从来没想过要发起一场全面的彩票诈骗，”蒂普顿告诉调查人员。

sentences.en: It occurred to me like, wow, I could do this.
sentences.zh: “我当时想，哇，我能做到这一点。”

sentences.en: I could be making a living doing this.
sentences.zh: “我可以通过做这个来谋生。”

sentences.en: He went on.
sentences.zh: 他继续说道。

sentences.en: If this was like some mob-related thing, I'd just give this information to the mob, and they would go out and win the lotteries left and right.
sentences.zh: “如果这是某种与黑帮有关的事情，我只要把这些信息给黑帮，他们就会去到处赢取彩票。”

sentences.en: Nobody would know.
sentences.zh: “没人会知道。”

sentences.en: But that, I don't have any mob ties.
sentences.zh: “但我没有和黑帮有任何联系。”

sentences.en: I don't know anybody.
sentences.zh: “我不认识任何人。”

sentences.en: I gave tickets to friends or family.
sentences.zh: “我把彩票给了朋友或家人。”

sentences.en: More than a decade ago, Tipton told them, he walked past one of the organization's accountants at the Multi-State Lottery Association.
sentences.zh: 十多年前，蒂普顿告诉他们，他路过“多州彩票协会”的一位会计师身边。

sentences.en: Tipton was conservative, the accountant liberal, and they often ribbed each other.
sentences.zh: 蒂普顿是保守派，会计师是自由派，他们经常互相打趣。

sentences.en: Hey, did you put your secret numbers in there?
sentences.zh: “嘿，你把你的秘密数字放进去了吗？”

sentences.en: The accountant said, teasing Tipton.
sentences.zh: 会计师调侃蒂普顿说。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: “你什么意思？”

sentences.en: Well, you know, you can set numbers on any given day, since you wrote the software.
sentences.zh: “嗯，你知道的，既然软件是你写的，你可以在任何一天设定数字。”

sentences.en: And that's when the idea first came.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，这个想法第一次出现了。

sentences.en: Just like a little seed that was planted, Tipton said in his proffer.
sentences.zh: “就像一颗被种下的小种子，”蒂普顿在认罪陈述中说道。

sentences.en: And then, during one slow period, I just had a thought that it's possible, and I tried it, and I put it in.
sentences.zh: “后来，在一段空闲期，我只是想这可能是可行的，于是我试了一下，并把它放了进去。”

sentences.en: The code wasn't a brazen, mission-impossible stunt of sneaking into the draw room with a malicious thumb drive.
sentences.zh: 这段代码并不是那种带着恶意U盘潜入开奖室的鲁莽的“碟中谍”式特技。

sentences.en: It was a simple piece of code, partly copied from an internet source, inserted by the one man responsible for information security at an organization that
sentences.zh: 它是一段简单的代码，部分是从互联网资源中复制的，由该组织负责信息安全的人员插入，该组织

sentences.en: runs three dozen United States lotteries.
sentences.zh: 运营着美国三打彩票业务。

sentences.en: Here's how the Multi-State Lottery Association's random number generators were supposed to work.
sentences.zh: 以下是“多州彩票协会”的随机数生成器本应的工作方式。

sentences.en: The computer takes a reading from a Geiger counter that measures radiation in the surrounding air, specifically the radioactive isotope Amerisium-241.
sentences.zh: 电脑从盖革计数器读取读数，该计数器测量周围空气中的辐射，特别是放射性同位素镅-241。

sentences.en: The reading is expressed as a long number of code.
sentences.zh: 读数表现为一长串代码数字。

sentences.en: That number gives the generator its true randomness.
sentences.zh: 那个数字赋予了生成器真正的随机性。

sentences.en: The random number is called the seed, and the seed is plugged into the algorithm, a pseudo-random number generator called the Mersenne twister.
sentences.zh: 这个随机数被称为“种子”，种子被输入算法，即一种称为梅森旋转算法的伪随机数生成器。

sentences.en: At the end, the computer spits out the winning lottery numbers.
sentences.zh: 最后，电脑吐出中奖彩票号码。

sentences.en: Tipton's extra lines of code first checked to see if the coming lottery drawing fulfilled Tipton's narrow circumstances.
sentences.zh: 蒂普顿多出的几行代码首先检查即将到来的彩票开奖是否满足蒂普顿设定的狭窄条件。

sentences.en: It had to be on a Wednesday or a Saturday evening, and one of three dates in a non-leap year.
sentences.zh: 它必须是在周三或周六晚上，并且是非闰年的三个日期之一。

sentences.en: The 147th day of the year, May 27th, the 327th day,
sentences.zh: 一年中的第147天，即5月27日；第327天，

sentences.en: November 23rd, or the 363rd day, December 29th.
sentences.zh: 即11月23日；或者第363天，即12月29日。

sentences.en: Investigators noticed those dates generally fell around holidays, Memorial Day, Thanksgiving, and Christmas, when Tipton was often on vacation.
sentences.zh: 调查人员注意到，这些日期通常在节假日附近，即阵亡将士纪念日、感恩节和圣诞节，而蒂普顿经常在这些时候休假。

sentences.en: If those criteria were satisfied, the random number generator was diverted to a different track.
sentences.zh: 如果满足这些标准，随机数生成器就会被引导到另一条轨道。

sentences.en: Instead, the algorithm would use a predetermined seed number that restricted the pool of potential winning numbers to a much smaller, predictable set of numbers.
sentences.zh: 相反，算法会使用一个预先确定的种子数字，将潜在中奖号码的范围限制在一个更小、可预测的数字集合中。

sentences.en: So, Tipton knew what no one else knew.
sentences.zh: 所以，蒂普顿知道别人不知道的事情。

sentences.en: For the Iowa hot lotto drawing on December 29th, 2010, there weren't really 10,939,383 sets of possible winning numbers.
sentences.zh: 对于2010年12月29日的爱荷华州热乐透开奖，实际上并没有10,939,383组可能的中奖号码。

sentences.en: There were only a few hundred.
sentences.zh: 只有几百组。

sentences.en: Late at night, before a draw that fulfilled his criteria, Tipton stayed in his messy, computer-filled office.
sentences.zh: 深夜，在满足他条件的开奖前，蒂普顿待在他那间凌乱、布满电脑的办公室里。

sentences.en: He set a test computer to the date and time of the coming draw, and he ran the program over and over again.
sentences.zh: 他将一台测试电脑设置为即将开奖的日期和时间，并一遍又一遍地运行程序。

sentences.en: For the first lottery he rigged, the November 23rd, 2005 drawing in Colorado, Tipton wrote down each potential set of winning numbers on a yellow legal pad.
sentences.zh: 对于他操纵的第一次彩票，即2005年11月23日在科罗拉多州的开奖，蒂普顿在黄色法律便笺簿上写下了每一组潜在的中奖号码。

sentences.en: He handed the pad.
sentences.zh: 他把便笺簿递给了他兄弟。

sentences.en: Each sheet had 35 or so sets of six numbers to his brother.
sentences.zh: 每一页上有大约35组六个数字。

sentences.en: It was a cheat sheet.
sentences.zh: 这是一张作弊小抄。

sentences.en: Instead of playing every possible number combination to ensure one combination won, he had to play only a few hundred.
sentences.zh: 他不必为了确保中奖而购买所有可能的数字组合，只需要购买几百组即可。

sentences.en: If you want a chance to win, you need to play all of these, Tipton told his brother.
sentences.zh: “如果你想有机会中奖，你需要买下所有这些，”蒂普顿告诉他兄弟。

sentences.en: I don't know if any of them will win, but you're going anyway.
sentences.zh: “我不知道它们中哪一个会中奖，但你无论如何都要去买。”

sentences.en: His brother was about to go on a Bigfoot hunting trip to Colorado, and these have a good chance of winning based on my analysis.
sentences.zh: 他兄弟正准备去科罗拉多州进行大脚怪狩猎之旅，而根据我的分析，这些号码中奖的几率很高。

sentences.en: Play them, he said.
sentences.zh: “买下它们，”他说。

sentences.en: Play them all.
sentences.zh: “全部买下。”

sentences.en: On a clear blue summer day in Des Moines last year, Eddie Tipton, a square-shaped, balding man who was then 54, trudged up the stairs of the Polk County Courthouse.
sentences.zh: 去年夏天，在得梅因一个晴朗的蓝天里，埃迪·蒂普顿，一个身材方正、秃顶、当时54岁的男人，拖着沉重的脚步走上波尔克县法院的台阶。

sentences.en: He wore blue jeans and a short-sleeved, salmon-colored button-up shirt, untucked and unbuttoned, with a blue t-shirt underneath.
sentences.zh: 他穿着蓝色牛仔裤和一件短袖鲑鱼色扣领衬衫，没塞进裤子里，也没扣扣子，里面穿着一件蓝色T恤。

sentences.en: His hands were shoved in his pockets, and his head was down.
sentences.zh: 他的手插在口袋里，头低着。

sentences.en: He had accepted a plea agreement for masterminding the largest lottery scam in American history,
sentences.zh: 他接受了一项认罪协议，承认自己策划了美国历史上最大的彩票骗局，

sentences.en: one count of ongoing criminal conduct, part of a package deal that allowed his brother to be sentenced to only 75 days.
sentences.zh: 一项持续犯罪行为，这是打包协议的一部分，该协议允许他的兄弟仅被判处75天监禁。

sentences.en: Tipton was here for his sentencing.
sentences.zh: 蒂普顿是来接受判决的。

sentences.en: In statements to prosecutors,
sentences.zh: 在向检察官发表的声明中，

sentences.en: Tipton painted himself in the most generous way possible, a kind of coding Robin Hood, stealing from the lottery and helping people in need, his brother who had five daughters,
sentences.zh: 蒂普顿以最慷慨的方式描绘了自己，把自己塑造成某种编码界的罗宾汉，从彩票中窃取钱财并帮助有需要的人，比如有五个女儿的兄弟，

sentences.en: his friend who'd just gotten engaged.
sentences.zh: 还有刚订婚的朋友。

sentences.en: I didn't really need the money, Tipton said.
sentences.zh: “我其实并不需要这笔钱，”蒂普顿说。

sentences.en: The judge noted that Tipton seemed to rationalize his actions, that Tipton didn't think it was necessarily illegal, just a taking advantage of a hole in the lottery's system.
sentences.zh: 法官指出，蒂普顿似乎在为自己的行为合理化，他认为这不一定违法，只是利用了彩票系统中的一个漏洞。

sentences.en: It wasn't all that different, Tipton believed, from insider trading, except laws didn't specifically prohibit him from fiddling with the random number generator code.
sentences.zh: 蒂普顿认为，这与内幕交易没什么不同，只是法律没有明确禁止他篡改随机数生成器代码。

sentences.en: His attorney equated what he did with counting cards at a casino.
sentences.zh: 他的律师将他的行为等同于在赌场算牌。

sentences.en: Tipton wasn't robbing the casino at gunpoint.
sentences.zh: 蒂普顿并没有持枪抢劫赌场。

sentences.en: He was cheating the house.
sentences.zh: 他是在欺骗庄家。

sentences.en: The other side disagreed.
sentences.zh: 另一方则表示反对。

sentences.en: Tipton was nothing but a common thief who happened to be handed the keys to the candy store, Miller, Sands' former boss, told me.
sentences.zh: 桑德的前任老板米勒告诉我：“蒂普顿不过是个普通的窃贼，恰好被交给了糖果店的钥匙。”

sentences.en: It's not a case of Sherlock Holmes' arch-nemesis Moriarty being a criminal genius.
sentences.zh: “这并不是夏洛克·福尔摩斯的死敌莫里亚蒂那种犯罪天才的案例。”

sentences.en: This is just a regular schlub who is a thief who happens to have knowledge of computer security.
sentences.zh: 这只是个普通的笨蛋，一个恰好懂点计算机安全知识的小偷。

sentences.en: From Tipton's point of view, it was complicated.
sentences.zh: 在蒂普顿看来，事情很复杂。

sentences.en: He had done something to see if he could do it.
sentences.zh: 他做了一些事，只是想看看自己能不能做到。

sentences.en: To his surprise, it worked.
sentences.zh: 令他惊讶的是，竟然成功了。

sentences.en: He said he inserted that code only once.
sentences.zh: 他说他只植入过一次那段代码。

sentences.en: After the code was approved by Gaming Laboratories International, machines containing it were shipped all over the country.
sentences.zh: 在代码通过国际博彩实验室的审批后，含有该代码的机器被运往全国各地。

sentences.en: He had created a beast and sent it into the world.
sentences.zh: 他创造了一头野兽，并将它放到了世界上。

sentences.en: You plant that money tree in your backyard, as Moss, the Wisconsin prosecutor, put it, and it's hard not to keep picking at it.
sentences.zh: 正如威斯康星州检察官莫斯所言，你在后院种下了那棵摇钱树，就很难不去一直采摘它。

sentences.en: In interviews, investigators had asked Tipton if he was proud of the success of his code.
sentences.zh: 在采访中，调查人员曾问蒂普顿是否为自己代码的成功感到自豪。

sentences.en: It was more like I'm ready for it to be gone, Tipton said.
sentences.zh: “更像是，我准备好让它结束了，”蒂普顿说。

sentences.en: It was never my intent to go out there and start winning all these lotteries.
sentences.zh: “我从来没打算去外面赢走所有这些彩票。”

sentences.en: It was just, like I said, step by step, it happened.
sentences.zh: “就像我说的，这只是顺其自然，一步步发生的。”

sentences.en: At sentencing, the judge asked if Tipton had anything to say.
sentences.zh: 在宣判时，法官问蒂普顿有什么话要说。

sentences.en: After a long pause, Tipton cleared his throat.
sentences.zh: 经过长时间的沉默，蒂普顿清了清嗓子。

sentences.en: Family members and former co-workers were in the courtroom.
sentences.zh: 他的家人和前同事都在法庭里。

sentences.en: Well, Tipton said matter-of-factly, I certainly regret my actions.
sentences.zh: “好吧，”蒂普顿客观地说道，“我确实对自己的行为感到后悔。”

sentences.en: It's difficult to say that with all the people behind me that I hurt, and I regret it.
sentences.zh: “面对身后所有被我伤害过的人，很难说出这些话，但我真的很后悔。”

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: “对不起。”

sentences.en: As the case was being litigated, Tipton had confessed to friends that he was wrecked with guilt.
sentences.zh: 在案件审理期间，蒂普顿曾向朋友坦白，他被负罪感折磨得心力交瘁。

sentences.en: At another point during the proceedings, Tipton leaned across a divide and extended his hand to Sand.
sentences.zh: 在诉讼过程中的另一个时刻，蒂普顿隔着隔板向桑德伸出了手。

sentences.en: Sand took the handshake as a sign of respect, as if Tipton had thought he outsmarted the system, but the system figured him out.
sentences.zh: 桑德把这次握手视为一种尊重的表示，仿佛蒂普顿认为自己胜过了系统，但最终被系统识破了。

sentences.en: On the day of his sentencing, Tipton told the judge he'd been taking classes to go into ministry.
sentences.zh: 在宣判当天，蒂普顿告诉法官，他一直在上课，准备投身宗教事业。

sentences.en: A deputy placed Tipton in handcuffs and led him away.
sentences.zh: 一名副警长给蒂普顿戴上手铐，将他带走了。

sentences.en: Earlier in the summer,
sentences.zh: 那年夏天早些时候，

sentences.en: Tipton sat in a conference room with Sand and law enforcement and lottery officials to give his full confession as promised in his plea agreement.
sentences.zh: 蒂普顿与桑德、执法人员以及彩票官员坐在会议室里，按照认罪协议的承诺进行了全面坦白。

sentences.en: Eventually, he would head to Clorinda Correctional facility in southern Iowa, near the Missouri border, where he remains today, offender number 683-2975.
sentences.zh: 最终，他被送往位于爱荷华州南部、靠近密苏里州边境的克林达惩教所，至今仍在那里服刑，囚犯编号为683-2975。

sentences.en: Through his attorney, he declined interview requests for this article.
sentences.zh: 他通过律师拒绝了本文的采访请求。

sentences.en: Tipton did not respond to nearly a dozen emails through the prison email system.
sentences.zh: 蒂普顿没有回复通过监狱电子邮件系统发出的近十几封邮件。

sentences.en: During a lunch break in Tipton's hours-long confession,
sentences.zh: 在蒂普顿长达数小时的坦白期间的午餐休息时，

sentences.en: Sand and others involved in the prosecution walked a few blocks to the High Life Lounge.
sentences.zh: 桑德和其他参与起诉的人步行几个街区去了High Life Lounge餐厅。

sentences.en: They ordered bacon-wrapped tater tots to celebrate.
sentences.zh: 他们点了培根裹炸薯球来庆祝。

sentences.en: Eddie sees himself as much brighter than the rest of the world, the sharpest tool in the toolbox, Sand says.
sentences.zh: “埃迪自认为比世界上其他人都要聪明，是工具箱里最锋利的那把刀，”桑德说。

sentences.en: It's the kind of thing I see in white-collar case after white-collar case, people who think they're better than everybody else, that people trust them
sentences.zh: “我在一个又一个白领犯罪案件中都看到过这种情况，这些人认为自己比别人都强，认为别人信任他们，

sentences.en: and love them, and that no one will be able to figure this out.
sentences.zh: 爱戴他们，而且没人能发现这些勾当。”

sentences.en: The judge sentenced Tipton to a maximum of 25 years in prison.
sentences.zh: 法官判处蒂普顿最高25年监禁。

sentences.en: His restitution payments to the various state lotteries came to
sentences.zh: 他向各州彩票机构支付的赔偿金总计

sentences.en: $2.2 million, even though, according to his attorney, Tipton pocketed only around $350,000 from the scam, the rest going to those who claimed the tickets.
sentences.zh: 220万美元，尽管据他的律师称，蒂普顿从骗局中只捞到了约35万美元，其余的钱都流向了那些兑奖的人。

sentences.en: Prosecutors did not believe that, pointing to Tipton's massive house, as well as the fact that Tipton and his brother owned 11 pieces of property,
sentences.zh: 检察官并不相信这一点，他们指出蒂普顿拥有豪宅，而且蒂普顿和他的兄弟在德克萨斯州费耶特县拥有11处房产，

sentences.en: either jointly or individually in Fayette County, Texas.
sentences.zh: 无论是共同拥有还是个人名下。

sentences.en: In Iowa, which has indeterminate sentencing, a 25-year sentence could mean Tipton is released much sooner.
sentences.zh: 在实行不定期刑罚的爱荷华州，25年的刑期可能意味着蒂普顿会更早获释。

sentences.en: Sand expects Tipton to be released by the Iowa Board of Parole within seven years.
sentences.zh: 桑德预计蒂普顿会在七年内被爱荷华州假释委员会释放。

sentences.en: Sand says he felt a deep intellectual satisfaction in solving the puzzle.
sentences.zh: 桑德说，他在解开这个谜题时感到了一种深刻的智力满足感。

sentences.en: The justice system at its best is really about a search for truth, but it couldn't go back in time and correct wrongs.
sentences.zh: 司法系统在最好的状态下确实是为了追求真相，但它无法回到过去纠正错误。

sentences.en: At the end of this years-long case, he came to a realization.
sentences.zh: 在这起历时多年的案件结束时，他产生了一种领悟。

sentences.en: He had grown weary of dealing with criminals.
sentences.zh: 他厌倦了与罪犯打交道。

sentences.en: In so much darkness,
sentences.zh: “在如此多的黑暗中，”

sentences.en: Sand says, I started to lose my light.
sentences.zh: 桑德说，“我开始失去我的光芒。”

sentences.en: A few months after the highest-profile case of his career,
sentences.zh: 在他职业生涯中最受瞩目的案件结束几个月后，

sentences.en: Sand went up to his boss and quit.
sentences.zh: 桑德找到他的老板辞职了。

sentences.en: He had decided to run for state auditor in the coming November election so he could make positive changes.
sentences.zh: 他决定参加即将到来的11月选举，竞选州审计长，这样他就能做出积极的改变。

sentences.en: If he wins, he will be investigating government waste, abuse, and fraud.
sentences.zh: 如果他获胜，他将调查政府的浪费、滥用职权和欺诈行为。

sentences.en: There's no way I would make a move to get away from the darkness of prosecution without finishing this case first, Sand says.
sentences.zh: “如果不先处理完这个案子，我绝不会离开起诉工作的黑暗，”桑德说。

sentences.en: So, finishing it, to me, was not merely satisfying.
sentences.zh: “所以，对我来说，结束它不仅仅是令人满足。”

sentences.en: It was liberating.
sentences.zh: “这是一种解脱。”

sentences.en: This was recorded by Autumn.
sentences.zh: 本节目由Autumn录制。

sentences.en: Autumn is an app you can download to listen to lots of audio stories from publishers such as the New York Times.
sentences.zh: Autumn是一款你可以下载的应用程序，用于收听来自《纽约时报》等出版商的大量音频故事。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天，选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场痛苦、混乱且有时令人兴奋的斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《Metro》节目中，我是莎拉·凯尼格，为您讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《Metro》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在任何你获取播客的地方收听。
